GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-10-11T01:49:23Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is it possible to calculate number of distinct keys in map?
Description: I have a map type field. Is there a way to calculate how many times each of distinct keys encounter in the whole table?

Say I have a table from the example in the docs:

`CREATE TABLE table_map (a Map(String, UInt64)) ENGINE=Memory;`
`INSERT INTO table_map VALUES ({'key1':1, 'key2':10}), ({'key1':2,'key2':20}), ({'key1':3,'key2':30});`

Can I write a query like this?

`SELECT
    a.keys,
    count(a.keys) AS cnt
FROM table_map
GROUP BY a.keys
ORDER BY cnt DESC`

This query counts distinct set of keys, but can it be rewritten to count keys?
